documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement Under Regulation 30(LODR) - Intimation Of Receipt Of Certificate Of Registration By Anand Rathi FME (IFSC) Private Limited
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance, highlighting consolidated total revenue of INR 336 crores and profit after tax of INR 116 crores, excluding certain items. Management expressed confidence in achieving its full-year guidance based on the strong business performance and healthy net inflows across equity mutual funds and other segments. The company also discussed various strategic initiatives, including the Board's approval to apply for an AMC license and the ongoing expansion of its digital wealth and international operations. Anand Rathi Wealth Limited released its investor presentation for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue from operations of Rs. 322.0 crores and profit after tax of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving the full-year revenue guidance of INR 1,415 crores and PAT guidance of INR 460 crores.
guidance.quote: Given the strong business we have built and the opportunities ahead, we remain confident of achieving our guidance.

guidance.claim: The company provided FY27 revenue guidance of INR 1,415 crores.
guidance.quote: We have given FY '27 revenue guidance of INR 1,415 crores and PAT guidance of INR 460 crores, again, going with the principles which Rakesh sir Rawal and Rathi ji has always taught and every elder in the company has taught us that under commit, over deliver.

guidance.claim: Management guided for INR 1,20,000 crores of AUM for the year ending FY27.
guidance.quote: Under the same principle, we are guiding you INR 1,415 crores and INR 460 crores for PAT and INR 1,20,000 crores of AUM for the year ending FY '27 is our guidance.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted green shoots of people with large wealth reaching out for wealth management services.
demand_outlook.quote: It is surprising that people with INR400 crores are reaching out, INR 500 crores. I did one meeting in Gurgaon. We had never seen these green shoots of people who need a service of wealth management reaching out to us and uncomplicated appealing to a large guy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has started operations in the UK.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also started operations in UK and very soon you all will see this business flowing from there and start contributing.

margins_costs.claim: The profit after tax margin for Q1 FY27 stood higher at 34.4% compared to 33% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax margin is higher at 34.4% for Q1 FY27 compared to 33% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated PAT margin stood at 34.4% for Q1FY27.
Employee benefit expenses for Q1FY27 were reported at Rs. 130.2 crores.
Profit after tax margin remained flat at 30.5% for Q4 FY26 compared to Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax margin remained flat at 30.5% for Q4 FY '26, which was at the same level in Q4 FY '25 too.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax margin improved from 30.7% in FY25 to 32.2% for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax margin improved from 30.7% in FY '25 to 32.2% for FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: In Q4 FY26, the company took a hit of INR 39.3 crores on account of ESOPs.
margins_costs.quote: And that is why on account of that, there is a -- in this Q4 FY '26, the company has taken a hit of INR 39.3 crores. So employee cost has gone up by that amount.

orders_capacity.claim: Total AUM grew by 21% year-on-year to INR 1,06,300 crores as of June 30th, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Total AUM grew by 21% Y-o-Y to INR1,06,300 crores as on June 30th, 2026, supported by the net flows of INR2,743 crores for the quarter despite high volatility.

orders_capacity.claim: Total AUM reached Rs. 1,06,300 crores as of June 2026.
In the flagship Wealth Management business, 1,600 new client families were added on a net basis in the last 12 months.
orders_capacity.quote: In our flagship Wealth Management business in the last 12 months, we have added 1,600 new client families on a net basis, bringing our total number to 13,395 individual families.

orders_capacity.claim: The Omni Financial Advisors SaaS platform has 6,906 subscribers with platform assets of INR 1.47 lakh crores for the year ended March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: The OFA business, Omni Financial Advisors business, which is a SaaS platform, has 6,906 subscribers with a platform assets of INR1.47 lakh crores for the year ended 31 st March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Total dividend for FY26 was reported as Rs. 13.0 per share amounting to Rs. 107.93 crores.
Anand Rathi Wealth Limited subscribed to its entitlement in the rights issue of Anand Rathi Global Finance Limited amounting to INR 40 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: And Anand Rathi Wealth Limited is holding about 8% in Anand Rathi Global Finance Limited, and it has only subscribed to its entitlement. So the total issue size, which was INR 512 crores, about 8% of that, that was about INR 40 crores that has been subscribed by Anand Rathi Wealth Limited just to continue to hold its holding in the NBFC at a price of INR 500 (per share).

risks_headwinds.claim: Client attrition rate in terms of AUM lost for FY26 is reported at 0.54% for the full year.
risks_headwinds.quote: Client attrition rate in terms of AUM lost for FY '26 is 0.54% for the full year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company achieved 24% of its full year revenue guidance and 25% of its full year PAT guidance during the first quarter of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: During the first quarter of FY27, we have achieved 24% of full year revenue guidance of INR1,415 crores and 25% of its full year PAT guidance of INR460 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the number of Platinum segment clients to reach about 450 to 500 in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, you will see my projection of the platinum number of clients in the next 2 years is about 450 to 500.

management_commitments.claim: The company guided for INR 1,415 crores of revenue for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We have given FY '27 revenue guidance of INR 1,415 crores and PAT guidance of INR 460 crores, again, going with the principles which Rakesh sir Rawal and Rathi ji has always taught and every elder in the company has taught us that under commit, over deliver.

management_commitments.claim: Management guided for INR 1,20,000 crores of AUM for the year ending FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Under the same principle, we are guiding you INR 1,415 crores and INR 460 crores for PAT and INR 1,20,000 crores of AUM for the year ending FY '27 is our guidance.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
